kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتزحزح (form IIq)
# أَتَزَحْزَحُ (ʔatazaḥzaḥu) /ʔa.ta.zaħ.za.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
# أَتَزَحْزَحَ (ʔatazaḥzaḥa) /ʔa.ta.zaħ.za.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
# أَتَزَحْزَحْ (ʔatazaḥzaḥ) /ʔa.ta.zaħ.zaħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
